title: Prepare history guards even after an unrelated CI typecheck fails

source.ref: Exact962 CI40442067567: type fixture failures skipped default-success history preparation, but contract guards correctly still ran

detail: CI guards intentionally run under !cancelled(), but preceding base-tip/history fetches used default success() semantics. When typing failed, the history steps skipped and shipped-id verification correctly refused its one-commit shallow window. Give both fetch prerequisites matching !cancelled() conditions (PR restriction retained for base tip). The earlier dated-fetch diagnosis was not supported: real local dated-fetch fixture succeeded, and completed job logs identify skipped preparation. Remove the redundant conditional-unshallow attempt. No history floor, seed, guard, budget or test skip changed.
